topics.name: nanoCMS Structure Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor/editor projection for site/page trees, routes, navigation metadata and MetaModule placements.

semantics.readonly_rule: Monitor is read-only by default; edit mode creates candidate structure only.
semantics.identity_rule: Site, page, route, placement and MetaModule identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: edit/move/place/unplace/apply operations use separate authorized workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/rearranging candidate structure grants no domain authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Containment/placement edges correspond only to explicit refs.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: dragging node mutates live site instantly
